environment.graph_events: enable_timing=True, external=True, captured INSIDE the segment graph

cache_probe.scope: System-wide non-CPU UCF DRAM; qualification only, not timing runs
cache_probe.note: Empirical streaming eviction proxy, not architectural invalidation or measured physical PIM handoff.

mha_conversion.note: Only K/V weights are tiled into eight physically stored heads. Original Q/O, residual widths, FFNs and ViT are unchanged. Not a trained MHA8 policy.

case_audit.native_blocks: Logical non-overlapping math blocks; summed isolated intervals are NOT full-model elapsed latency.
case_audit.composites: Alternatives overlapping native blocks; never add both tables.
case_audit.pim_candidates: FP32 logical tensors derived from native BF16 outputs; validate GPU implementation only, not numerical PIM hardware.
case_audit.host_setup_excluded: Static suffix mask constants are preallocated; host/H2D setup and external coherency/transfer remain outside segment timing.

cache_audit.scope: time embedding, time MLP, dense modulation outputs; not normalization or residuals
